upsert.title: Entrepreneurship World Cup 2026–27
upsert.summary: Global startup pitch competition with equity-free cash awards for idea, early and growth-stage startups, plus AI sub-tracks. Applications online; Global Finals planned in Riyadh in November 2027.
upsert.location: Online application; Global Finals in Riyadh
upsert.eligibility: Open to startups at all stages (idea, early, growth) applying globally across tracks. Exact country and incorporation rules are on the official rules page; not checked.

prize.description: About US$1M in equity-free cash awards across 12 winners: Early Stage grand prize $200,000 (runner-up $150,000, 3rd $90,000, 4th $50,000); Growth Stage $160,000 / $100,000; Idea Stage $30,000 / $20,000; four AI sub-tracks of $50,000 each. Currency shown as $ on the official page.

notes: Read from the official site: prizes, 31 May 2027 application close, selection July 2027. Rules and FAQ pages were not opened; a registration-window extension notice (Aug 2026) is linked from the site.

upsert.title: Enveda CASMI 2026 — Molecule ID From Mass Spectra
upsert.summary: Kaggle competition to predict 2D chemical structures of small molecules detected in complex biological extracts from mass spectra, run with Enveda.
upsert.eligibility: Check the Kaggle rules page for eligibility, team size and country restrictions; not confirmed.

prize.description: US$50,000 total prize pool reported from Kaggle's announcement; place-by-place breakdown not confirmed.

notes: Prize pool and 7 Dec 2026 deadline come from a news summary of Kaggle's post; the Kaggle page confirms title and description only. Verify on the competition page.
